chinese: 我猜这是我不刷牙或者每天刷三次牙才得到的惩罚。

english: It could be that, or maybe you're eating too many sweets.
chinese: 可能是这样，也有可能是因为你吃太多糖了。

english: In any case, I'll administer an anesthetic and you won't feel a thing.
chinese: 无论怎样，我会给你打麻醉，你根本感觉不到。

english: Alright, so talking about dentists and talking about wisdom teeth.
chinese: 好的，所以说到牙医和说到智齿。

english: You say that you still have all four wisdom teeth.
chinese: 你说你还保留着所有的四颗智齿。

english: I do. They're all still back there.
chinese: 我也是。他们都还在那边呢。

english: You didn't need to have them taken out or pulled.
chinese: 你不需要把它们取出来或者拉出来。

english: As my dentist likes to say, I have a big mouth, which in English has two meanings.
chinese: 作为我的牙医常说的那样，我嘴巴很大，在英语里有两个含义。

english: A big mouth is not just a large mouth, but also it means you like to talk a lot.
chinese: 一个大嘴巴可不是单单的嘴大，还意味着你喜欢说很多。

english: Right.
chinese: 好的。

english: But did you ever have braces for example when you were a kid?
chinese: 但你小时候是不是也戴过牙套？

english: Oh, yes.
chinese: 哦，是的。

english: Oh, you had braces?
chinese: 哎呀，你戴过牙套吗？

english: I had a retainer, which is a device that you...
chinese: 我有一个保镖，这是一个你...

english: It looks like a line across your teeth and you put it in usually at night,
chinese: 看起来像是在你嘴里的一条横线，通常是在晚上放进去的。

english: but sometimes during the day and it makes some space in your mouth.
chinese: 但是有时候，它会在白天占据一些你的嘴巴。

english: But I also had braces after that.
chinese: 但我也后来戴了牙套。

english: I hated braces.
chinese: 我讨厌牙套。

english: I had them for two years.
chinese: 我有它们两年了。

english: Why did you hate braces?
chinese: 你为什么讨厌牙套？

english: Because they're uncomfortable.
chinese: 因为他们不舒服。

english: Well, they don't look very good, especially when you're a 13-year-old girl.
chinese: 好吧，他们看起来不太好，尤其是你是个十三岁的女孩。

english: And you want to look cute and you have this big metal thing in your mouth.
chinese: 你想要看起来可爱，嘴里却叼着这个大金属玩意。

english: That's right.
chinese: 没错。

english: Did you have braces?
chinese: 你有没有牙套？

english: No, no, I never had braces.
chinese: 不，不，我从来都没有戴过牙套。

english: Actually, it was kind of for a while.
chinese: 真的，挺长时间才缓过神来的。

english: I think a lot of people thought it was cool to have braces.
chinese: 我觉得很多人都觉得戴牙套挺酷的。

english: I did not grow up when you grew up.
chinese: 我是在你长大的时候长大的。

english: It was not cool.
chinese: 那不是酷的。

english: I don't know.
chinese: 我也不知道。

english: I think...
chinese: 我觉得...

english: Or it gets to a point where in certain parts, I guess my school was filled with kids that had braces.
chinese: 它到了某个阶段，我觉得我那所学校可能挤满了戴牙套的孩子。

english: So I guess everyone just had really bad teeth.
chinese: 所以，看来大家都有一口坏牙。

english: So obviously the people that didn't have braces kind of were left aside.
chinese: 当然，那些没有戴牙套的人被忽略了。

english: So you're like, oh, I want braces.
chinese: 所以你是说，哦，我想戴牙套。

english: I want to be part of the group.
chinese: 我想加入这个小组。

english: Kind of like sometimes I wish I had glasses.
chinese: 有点像有时候我希望我戴着眼镜。

english: Because everyone I know has glasses.
chinese: 因为我知道的所有人都戴眼镜。

english: Really?
chinese: 真的吗？

english: Yeah.
chinese: 好。

english: It sucks to be perfect, right?
chinese: 确实，完美无缺很难的。你呢？

english: Well, this is a really interesting topic.
chinese: 嗯，这是一个非常有趣的话题。

english: And going to the dentist is always complicated.
chinese: 去牙医总是复杂的事情。

english: Maybe some of our listeners are dentists themselves.
chinese: 也许我们的听众中有些人本身就是牙医。

english: Or they can have some stories that you can share with us.
chinese: 他们可以分享一些你也可以和我们共享的故事。

english: Please let us know what you're thinking and share your dentist stories with us on EnglishPod.com.
chinese: 请告诉我们你正在想什么，并在英文Pod.com上与我们分享你的牙医故事。

english: We'll be waiting for you there.
chinese: 我们会在那里等着你。

english: All right. We'll see you guys then.
chinese: 好的。我们到时候见。

english: Bye.
chinese: 再见。

english: Bye.
chinese: 再见。
